text: This report recommends that the name "Irene Jaskulka Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located west of Spadina Road, extending between Bantry Avenue and Heath Street West. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Irene Jaskulka Lane" for an existing public lane located west of Spadina Road, extending between Bantry Avenue and Heath Street West.
